text:
marta: Heads-up — we need a lightweight social cascade for the product webinar next Tues. X + LinkedIn. Goal: drive signups and seed a benchmark narrative comparing latency/cost before/after Redwood Optimize. Can we map assets and a seeding schedule? :rocket:
kevin: I'm on it. Proposed slots: Tues 9am PT (tease), Tues 12pm PT (reminder), Wed 10am PT (post-webinar highlight). Want staggered threads on X and single long-form on LinkedIn.
sam: I can deliver 3 X threads (teaser, countdown, highlight) + 2 LinkedIn posts. Need hero screenshot, 30s clip, and quote cards. Share assets by EOD Thu.
marta: Asset list: 1) hero screenshot (16x9), 2) 30s demo clip (MP4), 3) 2 quote cards (1200x630), 4) benchmark chart png, 5) registration link + UTMs.
arya: For inbound routing: we should flag signups with "webinar_launch_may" tag and push to SDR queue A (kevin's team) for 24h follow-up. Also set up a nurture sequence for no-shows.
kevin: Confirm SDR queue A handles callers and ACV >= 50k. For smaller leads, route to growth-nurture. Can we add lead priority column in CSV?
sam: Uploading assets now to Drive: https://drive.google.com/example-webinar-assets (thumbs-up). Use filenames: hero.png, clip30.mp4, quote1.png, quote2.png, bench.png
marta: Copy notes: keep tone product-first + practical. Benchmark narrative: "Observed 3x latency improvement at 50% lower cost for typical 1k-token prompts." Need to be careful w/claims — legal will review.
kevin: Scheduling note: can we do an early-bird X thread the Monday before for APAC overlap? small follow-up push Tue 2pm UTC.
arya: Lead handling workflow (csv header suggestion): `email, name, company, title, score, tag, sdr_queue, followup_by` — I'll drop formatted CSV in #operations in a bit.
scheduler-bot: Scheduled post: X teaser -> 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z (creator: kevin). LinkedIn longform -> 2026-05-12T19:00:00Z (creator: sam).
kevin: Can we A/B test two captions for the LinkedIn post? short vs long. Sam — two variants pls.
sam: Will do. Variant A (short): "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference economics." Variant B (long): "We cut token cost and latency so product teams can iterate faster — benchmark inside."
marta: Quick checklist before asset handoff: legal check on benchmark language, final UTM, pick hero image crop, schedule approvals.
kevin: I'll own the seedlist: sending CSV to sam+arya for review by Fri 11am PT.
arya: I'll wire up routing rules once I get the CSV. Also will add a follow-up template for SDRs.
marta: Great. Post-launch: we'll monitor engagement and surface anomalies to Redwood Console team for any latency/regression mentions. If we see negative bench commentary, prep a rapid response thread.
kevin: Noted. Anyone want to own post-launch 24h monitoring? I can take first 12, marta can take next 12.
sam: I'll monitor creative engagement metrics (impressions, CTR) and swap creatives if CTR < 0.6% on X.
marta: Thanks all — next sync Fri 10am PT to confirm assets + final schedule. :calendar:
kevin: +1
arya: +1
